name: Green Iron Bracers

narrative.offerRewardText: Thanks much, adventurer. Here's your Darkmoon Faire tickets!
narrative.requestItemsText:
I'm working on a new costume, for when I have my own booth as the strongest woman alive! Right now I'm looking for some bracers I can wear. They can't cover much because people want to see my muscles, but I still want to flash a little color, you know?

How about green iron bracers, adventurer? Can you make me green iron bracers? If you can, then I have a whole bunch of Darkmoon Faire tickets for you.
